rounds.text: Duke Offshore Ltd is currently undergoing a significant operational turnaround, evidenced by a 93% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E10] and an 81% year-over-year net profit increase [E36]. This momentum is supported by a favorable sector tailwind in Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels, which provides a macro backdrop conducive to growth [E42, E44]. The company maintains a robust balance sheet with a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14x [E24], and despite historical volatility, it has managed to generate positive free cash flow of Rs 0.18 Cr as of March 2026 [E23]. While the market has reacted to these improvements with a 477% share price increase over the last year [E14], the high promoter holding of 70.61% suggests strong internal confidence in the company's trajectory [E27]. Conceded: [E1, E5, E6, E7, E21, E22, E32, E34, E40]. The current earnings profile is accelerating [E39], and investors should look past stale sentiment to recognize the shift in delivery [E43].
